grains.RAW.MILLS: one row per textile dyeing and finishing mill
grains.RAW.MILL_DAILY: one row per mill per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.STEAM_TRAP_SURVEY: one row per mill (steam trap leak survey snapshot)

metrics.Effluent Within Threshold: 100 * SUM(SAMPLES_IN_LIMIT) / SUM(WATER_SAMPLES) (internal demo threshold, not a regulatory limit)
metrics.Emissions Intensity: 1000 * SUM(CO2E_TONNES) / SUM(THROUGHPUT_TONNES) (kg CO2e per tonne of fabric processed)
metrics.Effluent Treatment Uptime: 100 * SUM(OPERATING_HOURS) / SUM(PLANNED_HOURS) (on-site effluent treatment plant, ETP)

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.exceedance_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(environmental exceedance in next 7 days) per mill, evaluated on an out-of-time holdout
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day group-wide CO2e emissions FORECAST; effluent COD ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.ESG_SOP_SEARCH over synthetic exceedance-response SOPs (one per mill type and cause)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.ESG_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.ESG_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, exceedance, cause and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (mills with observations, daily effluent within threshold, exceedances by mill, exceedance risk, IoT message count) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: IoT Core rule -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_TELEMETRY
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_ALARM_ALERT logs new ALARM readings to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)

aws.memo: Amazon Bedrock Claude Sonnet 4.5 via APP.BEDROCK_GENERATE
